Definition: adverb from G5561; at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition):--beside, by itself, without.
BiblicalUsage: Choris means without, apart from, separate, and the New Testament uses it for what we cannot do alone. Jesus says without Him we can do nothing, the writer to the Hebrews says without faith it is impossible to please God, and Paul says the Gentiles were without Christ and without hope in the world.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this little word carries the whole gospel, because apart from Christ we have nothing and in Him we have everything. I hold that every without in Scripture is an invitation to come and be joined to Him.
